inputs.text: President John Mahama made it clear that the nation's foundational policies must stay rooted in its established legal frameworks, longstanding cultural ethos, and the collective agreement of our society rather than yielding to outside influences. He stressed his dedication to upholding the rule of law amid these increasingly complex global discussions on human rights, which often serve as vehicles for progressive overreach that undermine national authority, traditional social order, and family values. “I took an oath to uphold [...]
